slots.name: eyebrow
slots.about: the small line over the unit name, such as its level

slots.name: lessons
slots.about: the unit's lessons in order: id (1 up, in order), name, done (true or false); 1 or more

slots.name: count_line
slots.about: the line under the unit name; may read done_count and total

slots.name: row_line
slots.about: the line under each lesson's name; may read it.name and it.step (1 done, 2 current, 3 locked)

slots.name: start_text
slots.about: the tag on the current lesson

slots.name: locked_line
slots.about: the note after a locked lesson is tapped; may read blocked_name and current_name

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the line once every lesson is done; may read total

slots.name: open_lesson
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: a lesson card is tapped (value: it.id); an open lesson goes to the host, a locked one shows the note

slots.name: complete
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: sent by the host when a lesson ends (value: the lesson's id); marks it done if it is open

slots.name: fold
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: folds or unfolds the unit's list

empty.shows: the first lesson is current and tagged; the rest are locked

attention.shows: a note says which lesson comes first, under the unit name

fallback.shows: every card is checked, no tag, and the done line shows

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, swap and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: each card's line says done, start now or locked in words, the current one carries a tag, and locked ones show a lock
